neutralPalettes.doc: The neutral palettes for light and dark surfaces.

sizes.doc: Size tokens for controls and chrome, in pixels.

spacing.doc: Spacing tokens on a 4-point scale, for padding, gaps and margins, in pixels.

statusPalettes.doc: The status palettes for light and dark surfaces.

surfacesOf.doc: Every surface of a neutral palette: `surface`, the containers and `titleBar`.

typography.doc: Typography tokens: the bundled Inter font and the oito2 type scale.

NeutralPalette.doc:
The neutral GTK-style surface, text and border colors of the oito2 base
scheme, for one brightness. Surfaces go from `surfaceContainerLowest` to
`surfaceContainerHighest`; `onSurface` and `onSurfaceVariant` reach a 4.5:1
contrast ratio on all of them, and `outline` reaches 3:1.

StatusPalette.doc:
Status colors for messages, badges and links, for one brightness. Every
color reaches a 4.5:1 contrast ratio, readable as text, on all surfaces of
the neutral palette with the same brightness.

TextStyle.doc: One style of the type scale.

TextStyleName.doc: The names of the type scale styles, from the Material 2021 type scale.

formatHex.doc: Formats a color as uppercase `#RRGGBB`, or `#RRGGBBAA` when it isn't opaque.

parseHex.doc:
Parses a hex color (`#RGB`, `#RGBA`, `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`, with or
without `#`). Throws a `TypeError` for anything else.

Rgba.doc: A color with 8-bit red, green, blue and alpha channels (0–255).

desktopEnvironments.doc: The Linux desktop environments oito2 recognizes, plus `unknown`.

detectDesktopEnvironment.doc:
Detects the desktop environment from `XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP` and `DESKTOP_SESSION`.

The `XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP` entries are checked in order and the first recognized one
wins; `DESKTOP_SESSION` is checked only when none is. Matching ignores case. Returns
`unknown` when neither value is recognized.

DesktopEnvironment.doc: A Linux desktop environment, or `unknown` when it isn't recognized.

DesktopEnvironmentSources.doc: The environment variables that identify the desktop environment.

Platform.doc:
Describes the platform an app runs on and the ergonomics that follow from it.

`Platform.current()` reads the running platform; the constructor takes explicit values,
so tests and previews can simulate any platform.

detectOperatingSystem.doc:
Detects the operating system from a user agent string, and from the
`navigator.userAgentData.platform` hint when the browser offers it. iPadOS reports a
Mac user agent; `maxTouchPoints` above 1 tells it apart. Unrecognized agents count as
Linux.

isTauriWebview.doc: Whether the page runs inside a Tauri webview.

operatingSystems.doc: The operating systems oito2 tells apart.

Density.doc: The input density of a platform: pointer (34 px controls) or touch (40 px controls).

OperatingSystem.doc: An operating system: the native one, or the browser host's on the web.

WindowButtonLayout.doc: The order and side of the window control buttons in a title bar.

resolveWindowControlStyle.doc:
Resolves the control style for `platform` and, on Linux, for its desktop environment.
Returns `none` on the web and on touch platforms; Linux environments without their own
style use `gnome`.

windowControlStyles.doc: The visual families used to draw window control buttons.

WindowButton.doc: A button that controls the native window.

WindowControlStyle.doc:
The visual family of the window control buttons: round GNOME buttons, KDE Breeze
glyphs, compact Xfwm glyphs, round COSMIC buttons, rectangular Windows buttons, the
native macOS traffic lights, or `none` when the browser or the system owns the window.

fallbackSystemSettings.doc:
Returns settings derived from `platform` only. On native Linux the desktop environment
defaults to `unknown`; elsewhere it is `null`. The control style and button layout follow
`resolveWindowControlStyle` and `WindowButtonLayout.defaultFor`; there is no accent color
and high contrast is off.

SystemSettings.doc:
The operating system preferences that shape an oito2 app: platform, desktop
environment, window controls, accent color and contrast. `fallbackSystemSettings`
derives them from the platform alone; `@oito2/ui-settings` reads the real ones.

setSystemSettings.doc:
Provides system settings to the components below the calling one. `get` is called on
every read, so passing a getter over a prop or `$state` keeps the settings reactive.
Must be called during component initialization.

useSystemSettings.doc:
Returns the system settings provided by the closest `SystemScope` (or
`setSystemSettings`), or settings derived from `Platform.current()` when there is none.
Must be called during component initialization.

SystemSettingsRef.doc: A live view of the system settings: `current` always reads the latest value.

SystemScope.doc:
Provides `settings` to the components inside it, which read them with
`useSystemSettings()`. Renders no element of its own.

props.name: settings
props.doc: The settings provided to the components inside.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content that reads the settings.

timeUnits.doc: The time units of relative times.

Localizations.doc:
The built-in strings of the oito2 components: window controls, pane and sheet handles,
relative times, the command palette, form fields, pickers and file uploads. English
(`en`) and Brazilian Portuguese (`ptBR`) ship with the library; a label passed to a
component always wins over these strings.

TimeUnit.doc: A unit of a relative time, such as `minute` in "3 minutes ago".

localizationsFor.doc:
Returns the built-in strings for `locale` (BCP 47, `_` also accepted): Portuguese for
any `pt` locale, English otherwise.

setLocale.doc:
Provides a locale and its strings to the components below the calling one. `get` is
called on every read, so a getter over a prop or `$state` keeps them reactive. Must be
called during component initialization.

supportedLocales.doc: The locales with built-in strings: English and Brazilian Portuguese.

useLocale.doc:
Returns the locale and strings of the closest `LocaleProvider` (or `setLocale`), or
English when there is none. Must be called during component initialization.

LocaleRef.doc: A live view of the locale and strings: both properties always read the latest value.

LocaleProvider.doc:
Provides a locale and its strings to the components inside it, which read them with
`useLocale()` and `useFormat()`. Renders no element of its own.

props.name: locale
props.doc: The BCP 47 locale, such as `en` or `pt-BR`. Defaults to `en`.

props.name: strings
props.doc: Strings that replace the built-in ones for `locale`.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content that reads the locale.

Format.doc:
Locale-aware formatting of byte sizes, compact numbers and relative times, such as
"1.5 MB", "1.23K" and "3 minutes ago". Numbers follow `locale` through `Intl`; relative
times use the localized `strings`. Plain numbers, dates and times use `Intl` directly.

useFormat.doc:
Returns a formatter for the locale and strings of the closest `LocaleProvider`, or
English when there is none. Must be called during component initialization.

ByteUnits.doc: The units of `Format.bytes`: powers of 1000 (kB, MB) or of 1024 (KiB, MiB).

FormatRef.doc: A live view of the formatter for the current locale: `current` always reads the latest.

setTheme.doc:
Provides a color theme to the components below the calling one. `get` is called on
every read, so a getter over a prop or `$derived` keeps it reactive. Must be called
during component initialization.

useTheme.doc:
Returns the color theme of the closest `ThemeProvider` (or `setTheme`), or the light
base scheme when there is none. Must be called during component initialization.

ThemeRef.doc: A live view of the active color theme: `current` always reads the latest value.

ThemeProvider.doc:
Applies an oito2 color theme to its content: renders a `div` carrying the theme's CSS
custom properties, its page background and text color, and provides the theme to
`useTheme()`. By default it follows the system: light or dark from
`prefers-color-scheme`, the accent and high contrast from the closest `SystemScope`
(and `prefers-contrast: more`). Overlays opened inside it (popovers, menus, dialogs) are
rendered at the end of that `div`, so they keep the theme.

props.name: mode
props.doc: Light, dark, or the system preference. Defaults to `system`.

props.name: accent
props.doc: A named accent or a hex color. Defaults to the system accent, then blue.

props.name: highContrast
props.doc: High contrast on, off, or from the system. Defaults to `system`.

props.name: light
props.doc: The theme for light mode, such as a preset. Defaults to the base scheme.

props.name: dark
props.doc: The theme for dark mode, such as a preset. Defaults to the base scheme.

props.name: children
props.doc: The themed content.

ListCollection.doc:
An immutable list of items with the accessors a list, select or autocomplete needs: a
unique string value, a display label, a disabled flag and an optional group per item.

Navigation methods skip disabled items. Methods that change the list return a new
collection.

ListCollectionOptions.doc: The accessors of a `ListCollection`; every one is optional.

ListGroup.doc: A group of items of a `ListCollection`; ungrouped items form the group `null`.

TreeCollection.doc:
An immutable tree of uniquely valued nodes, with the lookups and edits a tree view, a
file explorer or a nested menu needs. Methods that change the tree return a new
collection.

isTreeBranch.doc: Whether `node` is a branch, which can have children.

treeNodeLabel.doc: Returns the display label of `node`: its `label`, or its value.

TreeEntry.doc: A node with its depth (0 at the top level) and the index path that leads to it.

TreeNode.doc: A node of a `TreeCollection`: a branch when it has `children` (possibly empty), a leaf otherwise.

SelectionController.doc:
The selected values of a `ListCollection`, with the desktop selection gestures: plain
click, Control/Command click to toggle and Shift click to extend a range from the
anchor.

Its state is reactive: reading it in a template or `$derived` tracks it, and it only
changes when the selection really changes. Disabled items and values outside the
collection are never selected; `selectedValues` keeps the collection order.

SelectionMode.doc: How many items a `SelectionController` can select: none, one at most, or any number.

AsyncListController.doc:
Loads a list page by page from an asynchronous source, with filter text and sort,
for lists, tables and comboboxes that fetch their items.

Its state is reactive. A newer load supersedes a running one: the older result is
ignored and its request reports `isCancelled` (and aborts its `signal`). It doesn't
load until `reload` is called.

AsyncListPage.doc: A loaded page: its items and the cursor of the next page, or `null` after the last page.

AsyncListRequest.doc: What an `AsyncListController` asks its `load` function for.

SortDescriptor.doc: A sort column or field and its direction.

KeyChord.doc:
A key with the modifiers held while it is pressed, such as Control+K.

Keys are named like `KeyboardEvent.key` for named keys (`Enter`, `Escape`, `ArrowUp`,
`F5`…), with `Space` for the space bar, and as lower-case characters otherwise (`k`,
`1`, `,`). A chord with `primary` stands for Command+key on Apple systems and
Control+key elsewhere; `resolve` turns it into the concrete modifier.

Shortcut.doc: A keyboard shortcut: one chord, or a sequence of chords pressed in order such as `G H`.

usesCommandKey.doc: Whether `os` uses Command as its primary modifier (macOS and iOS) instead of Control.

KeyChordModifiers.doc: The modifiers of a `KeyChord`; every one defaults to false.

availableCommands.doc:
Returns the enabled commands of `scope` and its parents, inner ones first; an enabled
inner command replaces the outer ones with its id.

shortcutConflicts.doc:
Returns the pairs of `commands` whose shortcuts clash on `os`: the same shortcut, or
one that is a prefix of another (the longer one could never run).

useCommands.doc:
Returns the commands available at the calling component, as the command palette lists
them; empty outside every `Commands` scope. Must be called during component
initialization.

Command.doc:
An action an app offers: run from its keyboard shortcut inside a `Commands` scope, or
from the command palette.

CommandsRef.doc: A live view of the commands available at a component.

Commands.doc:
A command scope: runs its commands when their keyboard shortcuts are pressed while the
focus is inside it (or anywhere in the window with `global`), and offers them to
`useCommands()` and the command palette. Inner scopes override outer commands with the
same id. Shortcuts without Control, Alt or Meta are ignored while typing in a text
field, and the chords of a sequence must follow each other within `sequenceTimeout`.

props.name: commands
props.doc: The commands of this scope.

props.name: sequenceTimeout
props.doc: The longest wait between the chords of a sequence, in milliseconds. Defaults to 1000.

props.name: global
props.doc: Whether the shortcuts work anywhere in the window instead of only with the focus inside.

props.name: platform
props.doc: The system whose primary modifier the shortcuts use. Defaults to the running one.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content the commands apply to.

focusBorder.doc:
Draws a 2-pixel ring in the text-safe primary color around an element while it, or an element inside it, has keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`), as around a list, a card or a group of fields. The ring doesn't affect layout and doesn't show after pointer clicks. Needs `@oito2/ui/styles.css` (or `base.css`), which styles `data-oito2-focus-border`. ```svelte
…
```

edgeFocus.doc:
Moves focus between the focusable elements of a group with the arrow keys, by their
position on screen, and keeps it inside the group: at the edges the arrows stop instead
of leaving it or scrolling the page. Tab and Shift+Tab still move to the elements
around the group. Useful for grids of cards and toolbars of mixed controls.

Keys a control inside already handles (it calls `preventDefault`) and the arrows of
text fields are left alone.

draggable.doc:
Lets the user move an element inside its positioned container, with the pointer or, once focused, with the arrow keys. The element is placed with `position: absolute` at `left`/`top` from the container's top-left corner and joins the tab order. Give the element an accessible name, and a description such as the localized `moveWithArrowKeys` string, which tells assistive technologies how to move it. ```svelte
…
```

DraggablePosition.doc: A position in pixels from the top-left corner of the positioned container.

undershoot.doc:
Fades a soft shadow in at the start and end edges of a scrolling element while there is more content beyond them, as GTK does. The shadows are the element's `::before` and `::after`, kept in view with `position: sticky`, so the element must not use those pseudo-elements itself. A horizontal undershoot needs a flex row (the shadows stretch across it). With `pointerScrolling`, a horizontal scroll also follows the vertical mouse wheel. Needs `@oito2/ui/styles.css` (or `base.css`), which styles `data-oito2-undershoot`. ```svelte
…
```

pageTransition.doc:
The desktop page transition of @oito2/ui, as a Svelte transition: the page fades in
while sliding a short distance from the reading end side (from the right in
left-to-right text), and leaves the same way back. When the user prefers reduced motion
it takes no time.

```svelte
{#key page.url.pathname}
  <main in:pageTransition>…</main>
{/key}
```

IconComponent.doc: An icon component, such as one from `@lucide/svelte`, rendered at the control's icon size.

IconProps.doc: The props `@oito2/ui` passes to an icon component, such as a Lucide icon.

Button.doc:
A button with the five Material 3 emphasis levels: `filled` (the default, for the main
action), `tonal`, `outlined`, `text` and `elevated`. It is 34 pixels high with a pointer
and 40 with touch, with an optional leading `icon` and `trailing` content. With `href` it
renders a link that looks like a button.

props.name: variant
props.doc: The emphasis. Defaults to `filled`.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon before the label.

props.name: trailing
props.doc: Content after the label, such as a chevron.

props.name: href
props.doc: Renders a link to this URL instead of a button.

props.name: target
props.doc: Where a link opens.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button or link element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The label.

IconButton.doc:
A square button that shows only an icon, as large as a button is high. `label` names it
for screen readers and shows as its tooltip. With `selected` it is a toggle: selected, it
fills with the secondary container color and reports `aria-pressed`.

props.name: icon
props.doc: The icon.

props.name: selectedIcon
props.doc: The icon shown while `selected`. Defaults to `icon`.

props.name: label
props.doc: The accessible name, also shown as the tooltip.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether the button is a toggle that is on; leave it out for a plain button.

props.name: tooltip
props.doc: Whether `label` shows as a tooltip. Defaults to true.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

props.name: children
props.doc: Custom content instead of `icon`.

BackButton.doc:
An icon button with a chevron pointing back (left, or right in right-to-left layouts),
labeled "Back" in the active locale.

props.name: label
props.doc: The accessible name. Defaults to "Back" in the active locale.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

CloseButton.doc: An icon button with an X, labeled "Close" in the active locale.

props.name: label
props.doc: The accessible name. Defaults to "Close" in the active locale.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

Fab.doc:
A floating action button for the main action of a screen: a 56-pixel square in the
primary container color with a raised shadow, or a wider pill with a label (extended)
when it has `children`. `label` names an icon-only button.

props.name: icon
props.doc: The icon.

props.name: label
props.doc: The accessible name of an icon-only button.

props.name: size
props.doc: The size of an icon-only button. Defaults to `medium` (56 pixels).

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The label of an extended button.

nextCheckedState.doc:
Returns the state of a check box after a click: unchecked becomes checked, checked
becomes mixed with `tristate` or unchecked otherwise, and mixed becomes unchecked.

CheckedState.doc: The state of a check box: checked, unchecked or mixed (some of its items checked).

Checkbox.doc:
A check box: 20 pixels with a pointer and 24 with touch, in a target as large as a
button. It is checked, unchecked or, with `tristate` or a `mixed` value, mixed. Bind
`checked`, or set `defaultChecked` and listen to `onCheckedChange`. With `name` it
submits `value` in a form while checked.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Whether the box is checked, unchecked or mixed.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.doc: The state of an uncontrolled box before the first click. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.doc: Called with each new state.

props.name: tristate
props.doc: Whether a click cycles through the mixed state.

props.name: name
props.doc: The form field name.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value submitted while checked. Defaults to `on`.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

Switch.doc:
A switch that turns a setting on or off at once: a 42 by 24 pixel track with a pointer
(52 by 30 with touch). Bind `checked`, or set `defaultChecked` and listen to
`onCheckedChange`. `onOffShapes` adds "I" and "O" marks to the track.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Whether the switch is on.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.doc: The state of an uncontrolled switch before the first click. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.doc: Called with each new state.

props.name: onOffShapes
props.doc: Whether the track shows "I" and "O" marks.

props.name: name
props.doc: The form field name.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value submitted while on. Defaults to `on`.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

Root.doc:
A group of radio buttons, of which one at most is selected. The group has one Tab stop;
the arrow keys move between its items and select them. Items are `RadioGroup.Item`,
`RadioButton` or `RadioListTile`. Bind `value`, or set `defaultValue` and listen to
`onValueChange`.

props.name: value
props.doc: The selected value, or `null`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: The selected value of an uncontrolled group. Defaults to `null`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with each new value.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether every item is disabled.

props.name: toggleable
props.doc: Whether clicking the selected item clears the group.

props.name: name
props.doc: The form field name; the selected value is submitted under it.

props.name: orientation
props.doc: The layout of the items, for assistive technologies. Defaults to `vertical`.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The group element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The items.

Item.doc:
A radio button of a `RadioGroup.Root`: the ring alone, in a target as large as a button.
Give it an accessible name with `aria-label` or a `<label for>`.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value the item stands for.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

ToggleButton.doc:
A row that toggles a setting when clicked anywhere on it: any painted `control` next to a
`title` and an optional `subtitle`, with one focus ring around the whole row. Prefer
`CheckButton`, `RadioButton` and `SwitchButton`, which wire the control and the
accessibility state; use this one for other controls.

props.name: control
props.doc: The control drawn in the row; it must not take focus itself.

props.name: title
props.doc: The main label.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: A secondary line under the title.

props.name: controlAtEnd
props.doc: Whether the control comes after the text instead of before it.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

CheckButton.doc:
A check box with a title and an optional subtitle, toggled by a click anywhere on the
row. Bind `checked`, or set `defaultChecked` and listen to `onCheckedChange`.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Whether the box is checked, unchecked or mixed.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.doc: The state of an uncontrolled box before the first click. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.doc: Called with each new state.

props.name: tristate
props.doc: Whether a click cycles through the mixed state.

props.name: title
props.doc: The main label.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: A secondary line under the title.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

RadioButton.doc:
A radio button with a title and an optional subtitle, selected by a click anywhere on
the row. It must be inside a `RadioGroup.Root`, which holds the selected value.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value the button stands for.

props.name: title
props.doc: The main label.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: A secondary line under the title.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

SwitchButton.doc:
A switch with a title and an optional subtitle, toggled by a click anywhere on the row.
Bind `checked`, or set `defaultChecked` and listen to `onCheckedChange`.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Whether the switch is on.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.doc: The state of an uncontrolled switch before the first click. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.doc: Called with each new state.

props.name: onOffShapes
props.doc: Whether the track shows "I" and "O" marks.

props.name: title
props.doc: The main label.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: A secondary line under the title.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

CheckboxListTile.doc:
A list row with a check box, toggled by a click anywhere on it. The check box comes
first unless `controlPosition` is `end`; `secondary` fills the other side.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Whether the box is checked, unchecked or mixed.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.doc: The state of an uncontrolled box before the first click. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.doc: Called with each new state.

props.name: tristate
props.doc: Whether a click cycles through the mixed state.

props.name: title
props.doc: The main line.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: A secondary line under the title.

props.name: secondary
props.doc: Content on the side opposite the check box, such as an icon.

props.name: controlPosition
props.doc: Where the check box goes. Defaults to `start`.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the row can't be used.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The row element.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value the row stands for.

props.name: title
props.doc: The main line.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: A secondary line under the title.

props.name: secondary
props.doc: Content on the side opposite the radio, such as an icon.

props.name: controlPosition
props.doc: Where the radio goes. Defaults to `start`.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the row can't be used.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The row element.

SwitchListTile.doc:
A list row with a switch, toggled by a click anywhere on it. The switch comes last
unless `controlPosition` is `start`; `secondary` fills the other side.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Whether the switch is on.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.doc: The state of an uncontrolled switch before the first click. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.doc: Called with each new state.

props.name: onOffShapes
props.doc: Whether the track shows "I" and "O" marks.

props.name: title
props.doc: The main line.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: A secondary line under the title.

props.name: secondary
props.doc: Content on the side opposite the switch, such as an icon.

props.name: controlPosition
props.doc: Where the switch goes. Defaults to `end`.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the row can't be used.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The row element.

ListTile.doc:
A row of a list: optional `leading` and `trailing` content around a `title` and an
optional `subtitle`. It is 40 pixels high with a pointer (52 with a subtitle) and 56 or
72 with touch. With `onclick` it is a button, with `href` a link, and otherwise static.
`selected` fills it with the secondary container color; `square` drops the rounded
corners.

props.name: title
props.doc: The main line.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: A secondary line under the title.

props.name: leading
props.doc: Content before the text, such as an icon or an avatar.

props.name: trailing
props.doc: Content after the text, such as a value or a chevron.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether the row is selected.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the row can't be used.

props.name: centerTitle
props.doc: Whether the text is centered.

props.name: square
props.doc: Whether the row has square corners, for edge-to-edge lists.

props.name: href
props.doc: Makes the row a link to this URL.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The row element.

CircularProgress.doc:
A circular progress indicator: a ring that fills clockwise from the top with `value`
(0 to 1), or, without one, an arc that turns and grows while the work has no known end.

props.name: value
props.doc: The progress from 0 to 1; leave it out for an indeterminate indicator.

props.name: size
props.doc: The diameter in pixels. Defaults to 32.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.doc: The stroke width in pixels. Defaults to 4.

props.name: label
props.doc: The accessible name.

LinearProgress.doc:
A linear progress indicator: a 6-pixel bar that fills from the start with `value` (0 to
1), or, without one, a segment that slides back and forth while the work has no known
end. It takes the width of its container.

props.name: value
props.doc: The progress from 0 to 1; leave it out for an indeterminate indicator.

props.name: height
props.doc: The bar height in pixels. Defaults to 6.

props.name: label
props.doc: The accessible name.

Root.doc:
A card: a surface with a 1-pixel outline and large rounded corners that groups related
content. Compose it with `Card.Header`, `Card.Content` and `Card.Footer`.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The card element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content.

Header.doc:
The header of a card: a `title`, an optional `description` and optional `actions` at the
end, or any content as `children`.

props.name: title
props.doc: The title.

props.name: description
props.doc: A line under the title.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Controls at the end of the header, such as an icon button.

props.name: children
props.doc: Content after the title and description.

Content.doc: The body of a card, padded on every side.

Footer.doc: The footer of a card: its actions, aligned to the end.

props.name: variant
props.doc: The kind of chip. Defaults to `assist`.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon before the label.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether a filter chip is on.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.doc: The state of an uncontrolled filter chip. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.doc: Called with each new state of a filter chip.

props.name: showCheckmark
props.doc: Whether a selected filter chip shows a check mark. Defaults to true.

props.name: onRemove
props.doc: Called when the remove button of an input chip is clicked.

props.name: removeLabel
props.doc: The accessible name of the remove button. Defaults to "Dismiss".

props.name: ref
props.doc: The chip element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The label.

Badge.doc:
A small status mark in the error color: a 6-pixel dot, or a 16-pixel pill with `content`
such as an unread count. Around `children` (an icon or a button), it sits on their top
end corner.

props.name: content
props.doc: The text or count; leave it out for a dot.

props.name: max
props.doc: The largest count shown; larger counts show as `max+`. Defaults to 999.

props.name: visible
props.doc: Whether the badge shows. Defaults to true.

props.name: children
props.doc: The element the badge marks.

Separator.doc:
A 1-pixel line in the outline variant color that separates content, horizontal by
default. A `decorative` separator is hidden from assistive technologies.

props.name: orientation
props.doc: The direction of the line. Defaults to `horizontal`.

props.name: decorative
props.doc: Whether the line only decorates, without meaning for assistive technologies.

Root.doc:
A form field: ties a `Field.Label`, a control (`TextField`, `TextArea` or any control
rendered by `Field.Control`), a `Field.Helper` and a `Field.Error` together with ids, so
the label names the control and the messages describe it. `invalid` shows the error
look and the error message.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Whether the value is invalid.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the field can't be used.

props.name: required
props.doc: Whether the field must be filled.

props.name: controlId
props.doc: The id of the control. Defaults to a generated one.

props.name: children
props.doc: The parts of the field.

Label.doc:
The label of a field, above its control; it names the control and focuses it on click.
A required field shows an asterisk.

Control.doc:
Renders a custom control of a field through `children`, which receives the attributes
to spread on it: its id, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`, `aria-required` and
`disabled`. `TextField` and `TextArea` read the field by themselves.

Helper.doc:
A hint under a field's control, read by screen readers as its description. It hides
while the field shows its error.

Error.doc:
The error message of a field, under its control in the text-safe error color. It shows
only while the field is `invalid`.

TextField.doc:
A single-line text input: a filled box with an outline that thickens in the text-safe
primary color while focused, as high as a button. `leading` and `trailing` hold icons or
buttons inside the box. Inside a `Field.Root` it takes the field's id, description,
invalid and disabled states.

props.name: value
props.doc: The text.

props.name: leading
props.doc: Content before the text, such as a search icon.

props.name: trailing
props.doc: Content after the text, such as a clear button.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Whether the value is invalid. Defaults to the field's state.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The input element.

TextArea.doc:
A multi-line text input with the look of `TextField`. With `autoGrow` it grows with its
text up to `maxRows` instead of scrolling. Inside a `Field.Root` it takes the field's id,
description, invalid and disabled states.

props.name: value
props.doc: The text.

props.name: rows
props.doc: The visible number of lines. Defaults to 3.

props.name: autoGrow
props.doc: Whether the box grows with its text.

props.name: maxRows
props.doc: The most lines an auto-growing box shows before it scrolls.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Whether the value is invalid. Defaults to the field's state.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The text area element.

Root.doc:
A tooltip: a short label in the inverse surface color that shows next to its trigger
after the pointer rests on it for `delay` milliseconds, or at once when the trigger gets
keyboard focus. Compose it with `Tooltip.Trigger` and `Tooltip.Content`.

props.name: open
props.doc: Whether the tooltip shows.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.doc: Called when the tooltip opens or closes.

props.name: delay
props.doc: The hover delay in milliseconds. Defaults to 500.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the tooltip never shows.

props.name: children
props.doc: The trigger and the content.

Trigger.doc:
The element a tooltip describes. Pass `child` to render your own element with the props
it receives (the handlers, `aria-describedby` and an attachment), so the tooltip binds to
a button directly; otherwise `children` are wrapped in an inline element. The wrapper
opens the tooltip when the keyboard focuses the first focusable element inside it, which
the tooltip then describes, or takes the focus itself when there is none, such as around
text or a disabled button.

props.name: child
props.doc: Renders the trigger element with the props to spread on it.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content to wrap when there is no `child`.

Content.doc:
The label of a tooltip, rendered over the page next to the trigger (below it by
default), with a short fade.

props.name: placement
props.doc: Where the tooltip goes. Defaults to `bottom`.

props.name: offset
props.doc: The gap to the trigger in pixels. Defaults to 4.

props.name: children
props.doc: The text.

Root.doc:
A modal dialog. Compose it with `Dialog.Trigger`, `Dialog.Content` and, inside the
content, `Dialog.TitleBar` or `Dialog.Title`, `Dialog.Description`, `Dialog.Actions`
and `Dialog.Close`. Bind `open`, or set `defaultOpen` and listen to `onOpenChange`.

props.name: open
props.doc: Whether the dialog is open.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Whether an uncontrolled dialog starts open. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.doc: Called when the dialog opens or closes.

props.name: children
props.doc: The trigger and the content.

Trigger.doc:
The button that opens a dialog: a `Button` with the given props and label, or, with
`child`, your own element with the props it receives.

props.name: variant
props.doc: The emphasis of the button. Defaults to `filled`.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon before the label.

props.name: child
props.doc: Renders the trigger element with the props to spread on it.

props.name: children
props.doc: The label.

Content.doc:
The panel of a dialog, centered over a dimmed page while the dialog is open. Focus moves
into it and stays there until it closes, then returns to where it was; the page behind
doesn't scroll. Escape closes it, and so does a click outside unless `role` is
`alertdialog`.

props.name: role
props.doc: `dialog`, or `alertdialog` for a dialog that asks to confirm something.

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.doc: Whether a click outside the panel closes it. Defaults to true for `dialog`.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The panel element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content.

TitleBar.doc: The top row of a dialog: its title and a close button at the end.

props.name: closable
props.doc: Whether the close button shows. Defaults to true.

props.name: children
props.doc: The title.

Title.doc: The title of a dialog, which names it for screen readers.

Description.doc: The text of a dialog, which describes it for screen readers.

Actions.doc: The buttons of a dialog, at its bottom end.

Close.doc:
A button that closes the dialog: a `Button` with the given label (a text button by
default), the X icon button without one, or, with `child`, your own element.

props.name: variant
props.doc: The emphasis of a labeled button. Defaults to `text`.

props.name: child
props.doc: Renders the element with the props to spread on it.

props.name: children
props.doc: The label; without one the button shows an X.

AlertDialog.doc:
A dialog that asks the user to confirm an action: a title, a description and a confirm
and a cancel button. Only the buttons and Escape close it. Bind `open` to show it.

props.name: open
props.doc: Whether the dialog is open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.doc: Called when the dialog opens or closes.

props.name: title
props.doc: The question or the action to confirm.

props.name: description
props.doc: The consequences of the action.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.doc: The label of the confirm button. Defaults to the localized "OK".

props.name: cancelLabel
props.doc: The label of the cancel button. Defaults to the localized "Cancel".

props.name: onConfirm
props.doc: Called when the action is confirmed.

props.name: onCancel
props.doc: Called when the action is cancelled, with a button or Escape.

ScrollArea.doc:
A scrolling region with the oito2 scroll bars instead of the system ones: thin
rounded thumbs (6 pixels, 10 while hovered) in the text color at 30% (45% hovered, 60%
dragged), which show while the content scrolls or the pointer is over the region, or
always with `thumbVisibility`. The thumbs can be dragged and the tracks clicked to page.
While the content overflows, the scrolling area takes the keyboard focus, so the arrow
keys and Page Up/Down scroll it.

props.name: direction
props.doc: The axes that scroll. Defaults to `vertical`.

props.name: thumbVisibility
props.doc: Whether the thumbs always show. Defaults to showing them only while needed.

props.name: viewport
props.doc: The scrolling element, for reading or setting its scroll position.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content.

Root.doc:
A menu of actions opened from a button. Compose it with `Menu.Trigger` and
`Menu.Content`, which holds `Menu.Item`, `Menu.CheckboxItem`, `Menu.RadioGroup` with
`Menu.RadioItem`, `Menu.Group`, `Menu.Label`, `Menu.Separator` and `Menu.Sub`
submenus. It follows the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern: the arrows move between items,
typing finds an item, Escape closes.

props.name: open
props.doc: Whether the menu is open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.doc: Called when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: children
props.doc: The trigger and the content.

Trigger.doc:
The button that opens a menu: a `Button` (outlined by default) with the given props and
label, or, with `child`, your own element with the props it receives. Enter, Space and
Down open the menu on its first item, Up on its last.

props.name: variant
props.doc: The emphasis of the button. Defaults to `outlined`.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon before the label.

props.name: child
props.doc: Renders the trigger element with the props to spread on it.

props.name: children
props.doc: The label.

Content.doc:
The items of a menu, in a panel under the trigger (`placement` moves it). Choosing an
item, Escape, Tab or a click outside closes it.

props.name: placement
props.doc: Where the menu goes. Defaults to `bottom-start`.

props.name: children
props.doc: The items.

Item.doc:
An action of a menu, with an optional leading `icon` and a trailing `shortcut`.
Choosing it calls `onSelect` and closes the menu, unless `onSelect` calls
`preventDefault()` on its event.

props.name: onSelect
props.doc: Called when the item is chosen; `event.preventDefault()` keeps the menu open.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the item can't be chosen.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon before the label.

props.name: inset
props.doc: Reserves the icon space without an icon, to align with items that have one.

props.name: shortcut
props.doc: Content after the label, usually a `Menu.Shortcut`.

props.name: textValue
props.doc: The text typeahead matches. Defaults to the label.

props.name: children
props.doc: The label.

CheckboxItem.doc:
A menu item with a check box that toggles a setting; the menu stays open so several can
be toggled. Bind `checked`, or listen to `onCheckedChange`.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Whether the item is checked.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.doc: Called with each new state.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.doc: Whether the menu closes when the item is toggled. Defaults to false.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the item can't be toggled.

props.name: shortcut
props.doc: Content after the label, usually a `Menu.Shortcut`.

props.name: textValue
props.doc: The text typeahead matches. Defaults to the label.

props.name: children
props.doc: The label.

RadioGroup.doc:
A group of menu items of which one is checked, such as a sort order. Bind `value`, or
listen to `onValueChange`.

props.name: value
props.doc: The checked value, or `null`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with each new value.

props.name: children
props.doc: The `Menu.RadioItem`s.

RadioItem.doc:
An item of a `Menu.RadioGroup`: a check mark shows on the checked one. Choosing it
checks it and closes the menu.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value the item stands for.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.doc: Whether the menu closes when the item is chosen. Defaults to true.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the item can't be chosen.

props.name: textValue
props.doc: The text typeahead matches. Defaults to the label.

props.name: children
props.doc: The label.

Separator.doc: A line between groups of menu items.

Group.doc: A group of related menu items, named by its `label` or a `Menu.Label` inside it.

props.name: label
props.doc: The heading shown above the items.

props.name: children
props.doc: The items.

Label.doc: A small heading inside a menu or a select, above a group of items.

Shortcut.doc:
The keyboard shortcut of a menu item, in the platform notation: give it a `Shortcut`, or
text as `children`.

Sub.doc:
A submenu: a `Menu.SubTrigger` item that opens a `Menu.SubContent` beside it, on hover,
click, Enter or the right arrow (left in right-to-left layouts).

SubTrigger.doc: The item that opens a submenu, with a chevron at its end.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the submenu can't open.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon before the label.

props.name: inset
props.doc: Reserves the icon space without an icon.

props.name: textValue
props.doc: The text typeahead matches. Defaults to the label.

props.name: children
props.doc: The label.

SubContent.doc:
The items of a submenu, in a panel beside its trigger. The left arrow (right in
right-to-left layouts) and Escape close it and return to the trigger.

Root.doc:
A select: a button that shows the chosen option and opens a list of options to choose
from. Give it a `collection` to render the options and their groups by itself, or
compose `Select.Trigger`, `Select.Value` and `Select.Content` with `Select.Item`,
`Select.Group` and `Select.Label`. Bind `value`, or set `defaultValue` and listen to
`onValueChange`. With `name` it submits the value in a form.

props.name: value
props.doc: The selected value, or `null`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: The selected value of an uncontrolled select. Defaults to `null`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with each new value.

props.name: collection
props.doc: The options, their labels, groups and disabled states.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: The text shown while nothing is selected.

props.name: label
props.doc: The accessible name of the default trigger, when no `Field.Label` names it.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the select can't be used.

props.name: name
props.doc: The form field name.

props.name: children
props.doc: The parts; defaults to a trigger and the options of `collection`.

Trigger.doc:
The button of a select: the chosen option (or a placeholder) and a chevron, in a filled
outlined box as high as a button. Enter, Space and the arrows open the list. Inside a
`Field.Root` it takes the field's id, so `Field.Label` names it.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: The text shown while nothing is selected, when there are no `children`.

props.name: leading
props.doc: Content before the value, such as an icon.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content; defaults to a `Select.Value`.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: The text shown while nothing is selected.

props.name: children
props.type: Snippet<[{ value: string | null; label: string | null }]>
props.doc: Custom content, given the selected value and its label.

Content.doc:
The list of options of a select, in a panel under its trigger, as wide as it. The chosen
option takes focus when it opens. Without `children` it renders the options of the
root's `collection`, grouped.

props.name: placement
props.doc: Where the list goes. Defaults to `bottom-start`.

props.name: children
props.doc: The options.

Item.doc:
An option of a select: its `label`, or custom `children`, with a check mark when it is
the chosen one. Choosing it selects its value and closes the list.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value the option stands for.

props.name: label
props.doc: The text of the option, shown in the trigger when it is chosen.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the option can't be chosen.

props.name: children
props.doc: Custom content instead of `label`.

Group.doc: A group of select options under a small heading.

props.name: label
props.doc: The heading.

props.name: children
props.doc: The options.

Label.doc: A small heading inside a menu or a select, above a group of items.

Slider.doc:
A slider that picks a value, or a range with two thumbs, between `min` and `max`:
a 6-pixel track (8 where filled) with 20-pixel ring thumbs. `divisions` snaps it to even
steps; `marks` label points under the track; `label` and `valueText` add a header.
The arrows move a thumb by a division (or a tenth of the range), Home and End to the
ends. Bind `value` (a number, or two for a range), or set `defaultValue`.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value, or the start and end of a range.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: The value of an uncontrolled slider. Defaults to `min`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with each new value while the user drags or presses keys.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.doc: Called with the final value when a drag or key press ends.

props.name: min
props.doc: The smallest value. Defaults to 0.

props.name: max
props.doc: The largest value. Defaults to 1.

props.name: divisions
props.doc: The number of even steps the range snaps to.

props.name: label
props.doc: The heading above the slider; it also names the thumbs.

props.name: valueText
props.doc: Formats a value for the header, the value indicator and screen readers.

props.name: showValueIndicator
props.doc: Whether a bubble with the value shows over the thumb while dragging.

props.name: marks
props.doc: Labeled points under the track.

props.name: orientation
props.doc: The direction of the track; a vertical slider grows upward. Defaults to `horizontal`.

props.name: length
props.doc: The length of a vertical slider in pixels. Defaults to 192.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.doc: The accessible names of a range's two thumbs.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the slider can't be used.

props.name: name
props.doc: The form field name; a range submits two values under it.

sliderFraction.doc: Returns the position of `value` along the track, from 0 at `min` to 1 at `max`.

snapSliderValue.doc: Returns `value` clamped to `min`–`max` and, with `divisions`, rounded to the nearest division.

SliderMark.doc: A labeled point along a slider's track.

defaultWindowState.doc: The state of a window nothing controls: restored, windowed and active.

setWindowController.doc:
Provides a window controller to the components below the calling one; `get` is called
on every read. Must be called during component initialization.

useWindowController.doc:
Returns the window controller of the closest `WindowScope`, whose `current` is `null`
when there is none. Must be called during component initialization.

WindowController.doc:
Controls the window an app runs in. `@oito2/ui-window` implements it for Tauri
(`NativeWindowController`); tests and previews can provide their own. `state` must be
reactive (a `$state` field), so title bars follow it.

WindowControllerRef.doc: A live view of the window controller provided to a component.

WindowState.doc: The state of an app window, as the title bar shows it.

titleBarHeight.doc: The title bar height in pixels: 46.

windowControlLabel.doc:
Returns the label of a window control: the override from `labels` when there is one,
otherwise the localized string.

windowControlWidth.doc: The width of a window control button of `style`: 46 for Windows, 0 for `none`, 24 otherwise.

WindowControlLabels.doc: Overrides for the accessible labels of the window control buttons.

WindowControlType.doc: The action and glyph of a window control button.

dragRegionAttribute.doc: The attribute that marks the parts of a title bar that move the window.

titleBarGestures.doc:
Makes an element behave like a window title bar for `controller`: pressing its empty
background (the element itself, or descendants marked with `data-oito2-drag-region`)
moves the window, double-clicking it maximizes or restores the window, and the
secondary button shows the window menu where the platform has one. Controls on the bar
keep their own clicks.

WindowScope.doc:
Provides a window controller to the title bars below it. On the web, or before the
window is ready, `controller` is `null` and title bars show no working controls.

WindowControl.doc:
A window control button (minimize, maximize, restore or close) drawn in the look of a
desktop: `gnome`, `breeze` (KDE), `xfwm` (Xfce), `cosmic`, `windows` or `macos`
(traffic lights). `none` renders nothing. The glyph takes the text color around it,
except on macOS. The buttons stay out of the Tab order, like native ones.

props.name: type
props.doc: The action and glyph.

props.name: controlStyle
props.doc: The look of the button.

props.name: label
props.doc: The accessible label. Defaults to the localized label of `type`.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Label overrides by type, used when `label` is not set.

props.name: active
props.doc: Whether the window is active; inactive macOS buttons turn grey. Defaults to true.

WindowControls.doc:
A row of window control buttons in the given order, wired to a window controller:
minimize, maximize (restore while maximized) and close. The spacing follows the style:
none between Windows buttons and macOS traffic lights, 8 pixels otherwise.

props.name: buttons
props.doc: The buttons, in order.

props.name: controlStyle
props.doc: The look of the buttons.

props.name: controller
props.doc: The window the buttons act on; without one they do nothing.

props.name: onClose
props.doc: Replaces the close action, as a dialog does.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Label overrides by type.

TitleBar.doc:
A window title bar, 46 pixels high in the title bar chrome color: `leading` content, a
`title` (centered by default) and `trailing` content, with the window controls of
`buttonLayout` on their sides. Its empty background moves the window, a double click
maximizes it and the secondary button opens the window menu. `barStyle` hides the bar
(`hidden`) or its controls (`undecorated`). Most apps use `WindowTitleBar`, which
takes the style and layout from the system.

props.name: title
props.doc: The title, usually text.

props.name: headingLevel
props.doc: The heading level of a text `title`. Defaults to 1, the main title of the window.

props.name: leading
props.doc: Content at the start, after the leading window controls.

props.name: trailing
props.doc: Content at the end, before the trailing window controls, such as icon buttons.

props.name: barStyle
props.doc: How the bar is presented. Defaults to `normal`.

props.name: controlStyle
props.doc: The look of the window controls. Defaults to `gnome`.

props.name: buttonLayout
props.doc: Which window controls show on each side. Defaults to minimize, maximize and close at the end.

props.name: controller
props.doc: The window the bar controls. Defaults to the one of the closest `WindowScope`.

props.name: onClose
props.doc: Replaces the close action.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Label overrides for the window controls.

props.name: centerTitle
props.doc: Whether the title is centered in the bar. Defaults to true.

props.name: leadingInset
props.doc: Space kept free at the start, such as for the macOS traffic lights, in pixels.

props.name: height
props.doc: The height in pixels. Defaults to 46.

props.name: draggable
props.doc: Whether the bar moves the window. Defaults to true.

props.name: interactiveTitle
props.doc: Whether the title takes clicks (tabs, a search field) instead of moving the window.

props.name: bordered
props.doc: Whether a line separates the bar from the content. Defaults to true.

WindowTitleBar.doc:
The title bar of an app window, set up for the platform from the closest `SystemScope`:
the window control style and button layout of the desktop on Linux and Windows, room
for the native traffic lights on macOS, no controls and no dragging in a browser, and a
56-pixel app bar on touch platforms. The title is centered except on Windows. The window controller comes from the closest
`WindowScope` unless `controller` is given.

props.name: buttonSides
props.doc: Which sides show window controls, for apps split into panes. Defaults to `both`.

DialogTitleBar.doc:
The title bar of a dialog window or panel: a title and only a close button, on the side
where the desktop puts its close button, in the desktop's style (GNOME's on macOS and in
a browser). It is transparent and doesn't move the window. Inside a `Dialog` the close
button closes it.

props.name: title
props.doc: The title.

props.name: leading
props.doc: Content at the start.

props.name: onClose
props.doc: Called by the close button. Defaults to closing the enclosing `Dialog`.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Label overrides for the close button.

HeaderBar.doc:
A GNOME-style header bar: the window title bar of `WindowTitleBar` with `start`
controls, a `title` and `end` controls, and an optional search. With `searchable`, a
search button at the end swaps the title for a search field; Escape closes it and
returns focus to the button. `tabs` puts a view switcher in place of the title, such
as a `Tabs.List` of a `Tabs.Root` around the bar and the pages; each tab is
`tabWidth` pixels wide.

props.name: title
props.doc: The title, usually text.

props.name: headingLevel
props.doc: The heading level of a text `title`. Defaults to 1, the main title of the window.

props.name: start
props.doc: Controls at the start, such as a back button.

props.name: end
props.doc: Controls at the end, such as a main menu.

props.name: searchable
props.doc: Whether the bar has a search button and field.

props.name: searchActive
props.doc: Whether the search field shows.

props.name: searchValue
props.doc: The text in the search field.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.doc: The placeholder of the search field.

props.name: searchLabel
props.doc: The accessible name of the search button and field. Defaults to "Search".

props.name: searchWidth
props.doc: The width of the search field in pixels. Defaults to 280.

props.name: tabs
props.doc: A view switcher in place of the title, usually a `Tabs.List`.

props.name: tabWidth
props.doc: The width of each tab of `tabs`, in pixels. Defaults to 120.

BorderContainer.doc:
A container with a thin `outline-variant` border, the large radius and the surface as
background. `tint` washes it with a color instead: a border in that color over a fill
of it at `tintOpacity`, such as a status color for a highlighted note.

props.name: tint
props.doc: A CSS color the container is tinted with; replaces the background and the border.

props.name: tintOpacity
props.doc: The opacity of the tinted fill, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.1.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The container element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content.

Root.doc:
A titled group of content: a `Section.Header` with the headline and optional actions
above a `Section.Content` in a bordered container. The section is a `section` element
labeled by its header's headline.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The section element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The header and the content.

Header.doc:
The header of a `Section.Root`: the `headline`, which labels the section, and optional
`actions` at the end of the row, such as buttons.

props.name: headline
props.doc: The section title.

props.name: level
props.doc: The heading level of the headline. Defaults to 2.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Content at the end of the row, such as buttons.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The header element.

Content.doc: The content of a `Section.Root`, in a bordered container with large padding.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The container element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content.

Tile.doc:
A row with optional `leading` content, a `title`, a `subtitle` and `trailing` content,
as used in settings and property lists. With `onclick` the whole row is a button.
Group tiles with `TileList`.

props.name: title
props.doc: The primary text.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: The secondary text, below the title.

props.name: leading
props.doc: Content before the text, usually an icon.

props.name: trailing
props.doc: Content after the text, such as a switch or a value.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the tile can't be used; disabled tiles are dimmed.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The tile element.

TileList.doc: A bordered list of `Tile`s separated by 1-pixel dividers.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The list element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The tiles, in order.

Watermark.doc:
Places a faint `watermark` behind the content, for example a large icon in an empty
page. The watermark is hidden from assistive technologies and ignores the pointer. It
covers the area the content takes; give the element a size to watermark a whole page.

props.name: watermark
props.doc: The decorative content.

props.name: alignX
props.doc: The horizontal position of the watermark, following the text direction. Defaults to `end`.

props.name: alignY
props.doc: The vertical position of the watermark. Defaults to `center`.

props.name: opacity
props.doc: The watermark opacity, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.1.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content drawn over the watermark.

WatermarkAlignment.doc: Where a watermark sits, along each axis.

SelectableContainer.doc:
A container that can be selected, such as an option in a grid of choices. Selection
shows as a tinted background with a 2-pixel border in the text-safe primary tone. With
`onclick` it is a toggle button (`aria-pressed`).

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether the container is selected.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the container can't be used.

props.name: selectionColor
props.doc: A CSS color for the selected tint. Defaults to the primary color at 12%.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The container element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content.

Banner.doc:
A card-like surface for promoting content, such as an app in a store grid. With
`onclick` it is a button whose border strengthens on hover. Give it `title`, `subtitle`
and `icon` for the tile layout, or any content as children. `onHoverChange` tells when
the pointer enters and leaves, and `tint` washes the background with a color.

props.name: title
props.doc: The title of the tile layout.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: The text under the title.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Content before the title, such as an icon or an image.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether the banner is selected.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the banner can't be used.

props.name: color
props.doc: A CSS color for the background. Defaults to the surface.

props.name: tint
props.doc: A CSS color blended at 8% over the background.

props.name: onHoverChange
props.doc: Called with true when the pointer enters the banner and false when it leaves.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The banner element.

props.name: children
props.doc: Content of a custom layout, after the tile layout when both are given.

infoTypeIcons.doc: The icon that represents each kind of message.

infoTypeLabel.doc: Returns the localized name of `type` from `strings`, such as "Warning".

InfoBox.doc:
A message box tinted by its `type`, with an icon, a `title`, an optional `subtitle`,
extra content and `trailing` content such as a close button. The icon carries the
kind's name for assistive technologies, and warnings and errors are announced as they
appear.

props.name: type
props.doc: The kind of message.

props.name: title
props.doc: The headline, in the kind color.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: The message text.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Replaces the kind icon; unlike it, it carries no name for assistive technologies.

props.name: trailing
props.doc: Content at the end, such as a close or action button.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The box element.

props.name: children
props.doc: Extra content below the subtitle.

InfoBadge.doc: A small pill-shaped label tinted by its `type`, for statuses and counters.

props.name: type
props.doc: The kind of status.

props.name: label
props.doc: The badge text; replaced by `children` when given.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The badge element.

props.name: children
props.doc: Custom badge content.

ExpandButtonPosition.doc: Where the chevron of an expandable trigger sits.

Root.doc:
A section whose content an `Expandable.Trigger` shows and hides. Bind `open`, or set
`defaultOpen` and listen to `onOpenChange`. Compose it with `Expandable.Trigger` and
`Expandable.Content`.

props.name: open
props.doc: Whether the content is shown.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Whether an uncontrolled section starts open. Defaults to false.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.doc: Called with each new state.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the trigger can't be used.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The section element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The trigger and the content.

The header of an expandable section: a full-width button that shows or hides the
content, with a chevron that turns when open. With `headingLevel` the button sits in a
heading of that level, as the headers of an accordion do.

props.name: iconPosition
props.doc: Where the chevron sits. Defaults to `end`.

props.name: headingLevel
props.doc: Wraps the button in a heading of this level.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The header content.

Content.doc:
The content of an expandable section: a region labeled by the trigger, which grows and
shrinks as it is shown and hidden. `collapsed` shows instead while closed, such as a
summary.

props.name: collapsed
props.doc: Content shown while closed, such as a summary.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The region element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content shown while open.

Root.doc:
A bordered stack of sections, each with a header that expands its content. Unless
`multiple`, opening a section closes the others, so at most one is open. Bind `value`
(the values of the open items), or set `defaultValue` and listen to `onValueChange`;
`onItemOpenChange` reports each item that opens or closes. Compose it with
`Accordion.Item`, `Accordion.Trigger` and `Accordion.Content`.

props.name: value
props.doc: The values of the open items.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: The open items of an uncontrolled accordion; only the first unless `multiple`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with the values of the open items after each change.

props.name: onItemOpenChange
props.doc:
Called with each item that opens or closes and whether it is now open, including
the items closed by opening another, which are reported first.

props.name: multiple
props.doc: Whether several items can be open at once. Defaults to false.

props.name: dividers
props.doc: Whether 1-pixel dividers separate the items. Defaults to true.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether every item is disabled.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The accordion element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The items.

One section of an `Accordion.Root`, identified by `value`. Holds an
`Accordion.Trigger` and an `Accordion.Content`.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value that identifies the item in the accordion's `value`.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the item can't be opened or closed.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The item element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The trigger and the content.

The header of an expandable section: a full-width button that shows or hides the

The header of an expandable section: a full-width button that shows or hides the
