pageIndicatorGeometry.doc:
Returns the geometry of a page indicator. The current page is a pill three dots wide.
Interactive dots sit in boxes at least `minTargetSize` wide, which the spacing absorbs
as far as it can. `stepped` uses the full spacing up to 5 pages, three quarters up to
10 and half beyond; `bounded` uses the full spacing when it fits, otherwise as little
as needed to fit the width, down to half a dot.

PageIndicatorGeometry.doc: The resolved geometry of a page indicator.

PageIndicatorMetrics.doc: The measures of a page indicator, in CSS pixels.

PageIndicator.doc:
Dots showing the current page of a carousel or a paged view. The current page is a
wider pill in the text-safe primary tone. With `onPageChange` (or `interactive`) each
dot is a button; the current one is the group's Tab stop, and the arrow keys, Home and
End change the page. When the dots don't fit the width, it shows "page / length" instead.

props.name: length
props.doc: The number of pages.

props.name: page
props.doc: The current page, from 0.

props.name: onPageChange
props.doc: Called with the page of the activated dot or key.

props.name: interactive
props.doc: Whether the dots are buttons. Defaults to whether `onPageChange` is set.

props.name: dotSize
props.doc: The diameter of the dots, in pixels. Defaults to 8.

props.name: spacing
props.doc: The space between dots, in pixels; `layout` may reduce it. Defaults to 8.

props.name: layout
props.doc: How the dots are spaced. Defaults to `fixed`.

props.name: minTargetSize
props.doc:
The smallest width and height of an interactive dot's target, in pixels; the
spacing absorbs as much of it as it can. Defaults to 24.

props.name: pageLabel
props.doc: Builds the label of a dot from its 1-based page and the count. Defaults to "Page 2 of 5".

props.name: label
props.doc: The accessible name of the group of interactive dots, such as "Slides".

props.name: ref
props.doc: The indicator element.

Root.doc:
Tabs: a `Tabs.List` of `Tabs.Trigger`s and the `Tabs.Content` of the selected one. Bind
`value`, or set `defaultValue` and listen to `onValueChange`. `orientation` lays the
list out as a row or as a column beside the content; `variant` picks the look of the
selected marker: a pill in the secondary container color, as in GNOME view switchers,
or a faint accent tint.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value of the selected tab.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: The selected tab of uncontrolled tabs.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with the value of each newly selected tab.

props.name: orientation
props.doc: Whether the tabs form a row above the content or a column beside it. Defaults to `horizontal`.

props.name: variant
props.doc: The look of the selected marker. Defaults to `pill`.

props.name: activateOnFocus
props.doc:
Whether moving focus with the arrow keys selects the tab, instead of waiting for
Enter or Space. Defaults to true.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The root element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The list and the contents.

List.doc:
The row or column of tabs of a `Tabs.Root`, with a rounded marker that slides to the
selected tab. It is one Tab stop: the arrow keys, Home and End move between the tabs.
In a row, the pill tabs share the width equally unless `scrollable`; the subtle tabs
always keep their own width, start at the leading edge and scroll.

props.name: scrollable
props.doc: Whether the tabs of a row keep their own width and scroll.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The list element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The triggers.

Trigger.doc:
A tab of a `Tabs.List`, identified by `value`: a label with an optional `icon` before
it. A label wider than the tab ends with an ellipsis.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value that identifies the tab.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon before the label.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The label.

Content.doc: The panel of the tab with `value`, rendered only while that tab is selected.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value of the tab this panel belongs to.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The panel element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content.

TabsVariant.doc: The look of a tab list.

navigationLayout.doc:
Returns the layout of a navigation page: a bottom bar for touch below the compact
breakpoint (unless a rail style is forced), otherwise a rail that is compact below the
compact breakpoint, extended from the extended breakpoint and labelled in between.

navigationRailWidths.doc: The width of a navigation rail in each style, in pixels.

NavigationLayout.doc: The layout a `NavigationPage` picks for a width.

Root.doc:
A vertical bar of destinations at the start side of a window, in one of three styles:
icons only (`compact`, with the labels as tooltips), icons with labels below
(`labelled`) or a wider rail with labels beside the icons (`labelledExtended`). The
width animates when the style changes. The items scroll when they don't fit, and the
selected one is scrolled into view when it changes; `header` and `footer` stay at the
top and bottom. Bind `value`, or set `defaultValue` and listen to `onValueChange`.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value of the selected destination; `''` for none.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: The selected destination of an uncontrolled rail.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with the value of each activated destination.

props.name: railStyle
props.doc: How the destinations are shown. Defaults to `labelled`.

props.name: header
props.doc: Content above the destinations.

props.name: footer
props.doc: Content below the destinations.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The rail element, a `nav`.

props.name: children
props.doc: The `NavigationRail.Item`s.

Item.doc:
A destination of a `NavigationRail.Root`. The selected one sits on a rounded pill in
the secondary container color and is marked as the current page. With `href` it is a
link, otherwise a button.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value that identifies the destination.

props.name: label
props.doc: The destination name.

props.name: icon
props.doc: The icon.

props.name: selectedIcon
props.doc: The icon shown while selected. Defaults to `icon`.

props.name: tooltip
props.doc: The tooltip of the compact style. Defaults to `label`.

props.name: href
props.doc: Makes the destination a link to this URL.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the destination can't be used.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button or link element.

Root.doc:
A bar of destinations along the bottom of a touch layout: icons on a pill indicator
with their labels below. Bind `value`, or set `defaultValue` and listen to
`onValueChange`. `NavigationPage` switches to it for narrow touch layouts.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value of the selected destination; `''` for none.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: The selected destination of an uncontrolled bar.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with the value of each activated destination.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The bar element, a `nav`.

props.name: children
props.doc: The `NavigationBar.Item`s.

Item.doc:
A destination of a `NavigationBar.Root`: an icon on a pill indicator, filled while
selected, with the label below. With `href` it is a link, otherwise a button.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value that identifies the destination.

props.name: label
props.doc: The destination name.

props.name: icon
props.doc: The icon.

props.name: selectedIcon
props.doc: The icon shown while selected. Defaults to `icon`.

props.name: href
props.doc: Makes the destination a link to this URL.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the destination can't be used.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button or link element.

Root.doc:
Top-level navigation between pages that adapts to the width and the input. With touch
below `compactBreakpoint` the destinations are a bottom `NavigationBar`; otherwise they
are a `NavigationRail` at the start side: compact below `compactBreakpoint`, labelled
up to `extendedBreakpoint` and extended from it. `railStyle` forces one rail style.
The pages are `NavigationPage.Content`s; the selected one fades in, and the contents
keep their state when the layout changes. Bind `value`, or set `defaultValue` and
listen to `onValueChange`.

props.name: items
props.doc: The destinations, in order.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value of the selected destination.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: The selected destination of an uncontrolled page. Defaults to the first item.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with the value of each destination the user selects.

props.name: compactBreakpoint
props.doc: The width below which touch uses a bottom bar and pointer a compact rail. Defaults to 600.

props.name: extendedBreakpoint
props.doc: The width from which the rail shows labels beside the icons; never when unset.

props.name: railStyle
props.doc: Forces a rail style instead of choosing the layout by width.

props.name: separator
props.doc: Whether a 1-pixel line separates the rail from the page. Defaults to true.

props.name: header
props.doc: Content above the rail destinations.

props.name: footer
props.doc: Content below the rail destinations.

props.name: navigationLabel
props.doc: An accessible name for the navigation landmark.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The root element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The `NavigationPage.Content`s.

Content.doc:
The page of the destination with `value` in a `NavigationPage.Root`, rendered only
while that destination is selected. It fades in when it becomes the selected one.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value of the destination this page belongs to.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The page element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The page content.

paginationItems.doc:
Returns the page numbers a pagination shows for `page` of `count`, with `null` for an
ellipsis. It keeps `boundaryCount` pages at each end and `siblingCount` pages on each
side of `page`, and always returns the same number of items for a given `count`, so the
buttons don't shift as the page changes. An ellipsis never stands for a single page.
Pages count from 1, and a `count` of zero or less gives an empty list.

Pagination.doc:
Page navigation: previous and next buttons around page number buttons with ellipses,
and an optional page size selector. Narrower than `compactWidth` it shows only the
buttons around "Page 3 of 10". Pages count from 1. Bind `page`, or listen to
`onPageChange`.

props.name: page
props.doc: The current page, from 1.

props.name: defaultPage
props.doc: The page of an uncontrolled pagination at first. Defaults to 1.

props.name: pageCount
props.doc: The number of pages.

props.name: onPageChange
props.doc: Called with the page to show.

props.name: siblingCount
props.doc: The pages shown on each side of the current one. Defaults to 1.

props.name: boundaryCount
props.doc: The pages always shown at each end. Defaults to 1.

props.name: pageSize
props.doc: The current page size; one of `pageSizes`.

props.name: pageSizes
props.doc: The page sizes offered; the selector shows when it has entries.

props.name: onPageSizeChange
props.doc: Called with the chosen page size.

props.name: compactWidth
props.doc: The width below which the compact form shows, in pixels. Defaults to 420.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the buttons can't be used.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The pagination element, a `nav`.

stepState.doc:
Returns the state of the step at `index` when `current` is the current step: an error
first, then completed, current or upcoming by position.

StepState.doc: The display state of a step.

Root.doc:
A step indicator: `Steps.Item`s in order, those before `current` completed, with the
content of the current step. A step header moves to its step when `onCurrentChange` is
set (or `interactive`); with `linear` only the completed steps and the current one can
be reached. The steps run in a row with the content below, or in a column with the
content under the current step. `Steps.Prev` and `Steps.Next` move between them.

props.name: current
props.doc: The index of the current step, from 0; the step count when all are done.

props.name: defaultCurrent
props.doc: The current step of uncontrolled steps. Defaults to 0.

props.name: onCurrentChange
props.doc: Called with each new current step.

props.name: interactive
props.doc: Whether the step headers are buttons. Defaults to whether `onCurrentChange` is set.

props.name: orientation
props.doc: Whether the steps run in a row or a column. Defaults to `horizontal`.

props.name: linear
props.doc: Whether only completed steps and the current one can be reached. Defaults to true.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The root element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The items and the navigation buttons.

Item.doc:
A step of a `Steps.Root`: its circle (the number, a check mark when completed or a
cross on error), `title` and `description`, announced with its position and state. The
children are the step's content, shown while it is the current step.

props.name: title
props.doc: The step name.

props.name: description
props.doc: A short second line.

props.name: error
props.doc: Whether the step shows the error state.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content shown while the step is current.

Prev.doc:
A button of a `Steps.Root` that moves to the previous step; disabled on the first one.
Its label defaults to "Back" in the active locale.

props.name: variant
props.doc: The button variant. Defaults to `text`.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

props.name: children
props.doc: Custom button content.

Next.doc:
A button of a `Steps.Root` that moves to the next step; disabled once every step is done.
Its label defaults to "Next" in the active locale.

props.name: variant
props.doc: The button variant. Defaults to `filled`.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

props.name: children
props.doc: Custom button content.

tocActiveIndex.doc:
Returns the current section of a table of contents: the last section whose heading has
reached `activationOffset` below the top of the viewport, or the last section at the
end of the view. Without a heading above that line, the section before the first one
below it is current; without any measured heading, the previous section stays.

TableOfContents.doc:
A list of the sections of a scrolling view that highlights the section in view and
scrolls to a section when it is picked. Each entry points at its heading by element id.
The current section is the last one whose heading has reached `activationOffset`
pixels below the top of the view, or the last section when the view is scrolled to the
end. The view is `scrollContainer`, or the page when it isn't given.

props.name: entries
props.doc: The sections, in document order.

props.name: scrollContainer
props.doc: The scrolling element that holds the headings. Defaults to the page.

props.name: activationOffset
props.doc: How far below the top of the view a heading makes its section current, in pixels. Defaults to 32.

props.name: onSelect
props.doc: Called with the index of a picked section, before the view scrolls to it.

props.name: active
props.doc: The index of the current section; read it with `bind:active`.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The list element, a `nav`.

PanedView.doc:
Splits its area between a `pane` and the page (the children), separated by a divider.
When `resizable`, the divider can be dragged or, once focused, moved with the arrow
keys, and assistive technologies read it as an adjustable separator. The pane never
shrinks below `minPaneSize` and never leaves less than `minPageSize` for the page.
Bind `paneSize`, or set `defaultPaneSize` and listen to `onPaneSizeChange`.

props.name: pane
props.doc: The side content, such as a list.

props.name: paneSide
props.doc: Which side the pane is on. Defaults to `start`.

props.name: paneSize
props.doc: The pane width (or height, when stacked), in pixels.

props.name: defaultPaneSize
props.doc: The pane size of an uncontrolled view. Defaults to 280.

props.name: onPaneSizeChange
props.doc: Called with the new pane size while it is resized.

props.name: minPaneSize
props.doc: The smallest pane size, in pixels. Defaults to 180.

props.name: minPageSize
props.doc: The smallest size left for the page, in pixels. Defaults to 320.

props.name: resizable
props.doc: Whether the divider can be moved. Defaults to true.

props.name: keyboardStep
props.doc: How far one arrow key press moves the divider, in pixels. Defaults to 16.

props.name: resizeLabel
props.doc: The accessible name of the divider. Defaults to "Resize pane".

props.name: ref
props.doc: The root element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The main content.

PaneSide.doc: The side of a `PanedView` its pane is on; `start` and `end` follow the text direction.

fitSplitter.doc:
Lays the panes out in `available` pixels: keeping the proportions of `previous` when
it has as many panes, or else from the initial fractions, with collapsed panes at their
collapsed size and every pane within its limits.

moveDivider.doc:
Moves the divider after pane `i` by `delta` pixels toward the end, keeping both of its
panes within their limits. Returns the new layout, or `null` when nothing moves.

toggleDivider.doc:
Collapses or restores the collapsible pane next to divider `i`, preferring the one
before it; the neighbor takes or gives the difference. Returns `null` when neither
pane is collapsible.

SplitterLayout.doc: The sizes and collapsed flags of a splitter's panes.

SplitterPaneLimits.doc: The limits of one pane of a splitter.

Root.doc:
Panes side by side, or stacked when `orientation` is vertical, with a draggable divider
between each two. A divider keeps both of its panes within their limits. From the
keyboard a focused divider moves by `keyboardStep` with the arrow keys, Home and End
take the pane before it to its smallest and largest size, and Enter or Space collapses
or restores the collapsible pane next to it, as a double click does. Splitters nest.
For a single resizable side pane, `PanedView` is simpler.

props.name: orientation
props.doc: Whether the panes sit side by side or stacked. Defaults to `horizontal`.

props.name: onSizesChange
props.doc: Called with the pane sizes, in pixels, after each change.

props.name: keyboardStep
props.doc: How far one arrow key press moves a divider, in pixels. Defaults to 16.

props.name: resizeLabel
props.doc: The accessible name of the dividers. Defaults to "Resize pane".

props.name: ref
props.doc: The root element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The `Splitter.Pane`s; two or more.

Pane.doc:
A pane of a `Splitter.Root`, with a divider after it unless it is the last one. Its
size starts at `initialFraction` of the space (the panes without one share the rest)
and stays between `minSize` and `maxSize`. A `collapsible` pane collapses to
`collapsedSize` from the divider next to it.

props.name: initialFraction
props.doc: The share of the space at start, from 0 to 1.

props.name: minSize
props.doc: The smallest size, in pixels. Defaults to 48.

props.name: maxSize
props.doc: The largest size, in pixels. Defaults to no limit.

props.name: collapsible
props.doc: Whether the pane can collapse to `collapsedSize`.

props.name: collapsedSize
props.doc: The size of the collapsed pane, in pixels. Defaults to 0.

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.doc: Whether the pane starts collapsed; needs `collapsible`.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The pane element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content.

Root.doc:
A list of items (the master) next to the page of the selected item (the detail), as in
settings apps. At or above `breakpoint` wide the master is a resizable pane beside the
detail and an item is always selected. Below it the master fills the area, selecting an
item shows its detail instead, and the detail header's back button returns to the list,
clearing the selection. The selection survives switching between the two layouts.
Compose it with `MasterDetail.Master` (with `MasterHeader`, `List` of `Tile`s and
`MasterFooter`) and `MasterDetail.Detail` (with `DetailHeader`).

props.name: value
props.doc: The value of the selected item, or `null` for none.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: The selected item of an uncontrolled page. Defaults to `null`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with each new selection.

props.name: breakpoint
props.doc: The width at which master and detail sit side by side, in pixels. Defaults to 620.

props.name: paneSize
props.doc: The master pane width, in pixels.

props.name: defaultPaneSize
props.doc: The master pane width of an uncontrolled page. Defaults to 280.

props.name: onPaneSizeChange
props.doc: Called with the new pane width while it is resized.

props.name: minPaneSize
props.doc: The smallest master pane width, in pixels. Defaults to 180.

props.name: minPageSize
props.doc: The smallest width left for the detail, in pixels. Defaults to 320.

props.name: resizable
props.doc: Whether the master pane can be resized. Defaults to true.

props.name: resizeLabel
props.doc: The accessible name of the divider. Defaults to "Resize pane".

props.name: ref
props.doc: The root element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The master and the detail.

Master.doc:
The master pane of a `MasterDetail.Root`: an optional `MasterDetail.MasterHeader`, the
`MasterDetail.List` and an optional `MasterDetail.MasterFooter`, on the chrome main bar
color.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The pane element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The header, the list and the footer.

MasterHeader.doc: A bar above the master list, such as a title bar with a search field.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The header element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content.

List.doc:
The scrolling list of the master pane, holding `MasterDetail.Tile`s. It keeps the
selected tile in view. Without tiles it shows `empty`, while the header and the footer
stay, so a search that matches nothing can still be cleared.

props.name: empty
props.doc: Content shown when there are no tiles.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The list element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The tiles.

Tile.doc:
A tile of the master list, identified by `value`: a `ListTile` that selects its item
and shows as selected while its page is shown.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value that identifies the item.

props.name: title
props.doc: The primary text.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: The secondary text.

props.name: leading
props.doc: Content before the text, usually an icon.

props.name: trailing
props.doc: Content after the text.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the tile can't be used.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The tile element.

MasterFooter.doc: Content below the master list, such as an action button.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The footer element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content.

Detail.doc:
The detail page of a `MasterDetail.Root`. The children receive the selected value;
`empty` shows when nothing is selected. Start it with a `MasterDetail.DetailHeader`.

props.name: empty
props.doc: Content shown when nothing is selected.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The page element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The page of the selected item.

DetailHeader.doc:
The header of a detail page: the `title` and `actions`, with a back button to the
master list in the narrow layout.

props.name: title
props.doc: The page title.

props.name: level
props.doc: The heading level of the title. Defaults to 2.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Content at the end, such as icon buttons.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The header element.

PageController.doc:
Holds the number of pages and the selected page of a navigation component, reactively.
An `index` of -1 means no page is selected.

CarouselController.doc:
Controls a carousel: the slides, the current page and page changes. `Carousel.Root`
creates one, shares it with its parts and exposes it through its bindable `controller`.

Root.doc:
A row of pages shown one at a time. Pages change by `Carousel.Prev` and `Carousel.Next`,
the dots of `Carousel.Indicators`, the Left and Right arrow keys (swapped in
right-to-left text) while the carousel has focus, or a swipe, also with a mouse. With
`loop` the buttons and arrows wrap around, jumping straight to the other end. With
`autoScroll` it moves to the next page every `interval` milliseconds while no pointer
hovers it, nothing inside it has focus and motion isn't reduced. Bind `page`, or set
`defaultPage` and listen to `onPageChange`; setting `page` scrolls to it.

props.name: page
props.doc: The current page, from 0.

props.name: defaultPage
props.doc: The first page of an uncontrolled carousel. Defaults to 0.

props.name: onPageChange
props.doc: Called with each new page.

props.name: loop
props.doc: Whether going past the last page returns to the first, and back. Defaults to true.

props.name: autoScroll
props.doc: Whether the carousel advances by itself. Defaults to false.

props.name: interval
props.doc: The time each page stays when `autoScroll`, in milliseconds. Defaults to 4000.

props.name: controller
props.doc: The controller of this carousel, for changing its page from outside; bind it to read it.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The root element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The viewport, the buttons and the indicators.

Viewport.doc:
The scrolling row of `Carousel.Item`s, one page at a time, `height` pixels tall. It
snaps to a page after a swipe; with a mouse the pages can be dragged too. Place
`Carousel.Prev` and `Carousel.Next` inside it to show them over the pages.

props.name: height
props.doc: The height of the pages, in pixels. Defaults to 240.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The scrolling element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The items, and the buttons shown over them.

Item.doc: A page of a `Carousel.Viewport`, as wide as the viewport, announced as "slide 2 of 5".

props.name: ref
props.doc: The page element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content.

Prev.doc:
The button of a carousel that shows the previous page, at the start side over the
pages. Place it inside `Carousel.Viewport`.

props.name: label
props.doc: The accessible name. Defaults to "Previous page".

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

Next.doc:
The button of a carousel that shows the next page, at the end side over the
pages. Place it inside `Carousel.Viewport`.

props.name: label
props.doc: The accessible name. Defaults to "Next page".

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

Indicators.doc:
The dots of a carousel, below the pages: a `PageIndicator` that fits the width and moves
to the page of the activated dot. Hidden with fewer than two pages.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The indicator element.

Swap.doc:
Animates between two visual states, such as a copy icon that turns into a check mark or
a play button that becomes pause. It shows `on` while `swapped` and `off` otherwise,
changing with `effect`; with reduced motion the change is instant. The hidden state
stays mounted but out of reach of the pointer, the keyboard and assistive technologies.

props.name: swapped
props.doc: Whether `on` is shown.

props.name: off
props.doc: The content shown while not swapped.

props.name: on
props.doc: The content shown while swapped.

props.name: effect
props.doc: The transition. Defaults to `fade`.

props.name: duration
props.doc: The transition duration, in milliseconds. Defaults to 200.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The element.

OptionButton.doc:
A small square outlined button for secondary options, such as the buttons next to a
list. It shows an `icon`, custom children or, with `color`, a color swatch. `label`
names it for assistive technologies and is its tooltip; it is required for an icon or
a swatch.

props.name: icon
props.doc: The icon.

props.name: color
props.doc: A CSS color shown as a swatch instead of an icon.

props.name: label
props.doc: The accessible name and tooltip.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

props.name: children
props.doc: Custom content instead of the icon or swatch.

ColorDisk.doc:
A round color swatch that can be selected, as in accent color pickers. A ring in the
disk's own hue surrounds it while `selected`, and a fainter one while the pointer
hovers it or it has keyboard focus. A disk with less than 3:1 contrast with the surface
gets a thin outline, so it doesn't blend into the background. `label` names it for
assistive technologies and is its tooltip.

props.name: color
props.doc: The swatch color, as a hex string.

props.name: label
props.doc: The color name, for assistive technologies and the tooltip.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether this color is the selected one.

props.name: size
props.doc: The disk diameter without its ring, in pixels. Defaults to 20.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

SplitButton.doc:
A button with a main action and an attached arrow that opens a menu of related
actions. The children are the main label and `onclick` its action; `menu` holds the
`Menu.Item`s. `disabled` turns off both parts.

props.name: variant
props.doc: The look of both parts. Defaults to `elevated`.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon before the label.

props.name: menu
props.doc: The menu entries, usually `Menu.Item`s.

props.name: menuLabel
props.doc: The accessible name of the arrow part. Defaults to "More options".

props.name: ref
props.doc: The main button element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The main label.

toggleValues.doc:
Returns the values that are on after toggling `value`: with `multiple` it turns on or
off by itself; otherwise turning it on turns the others off, and turning the only one
off is allowed only when `deselectable`. Returns `null` when nothing changes.

Root.doc:
A joined row (or column) of buttons that turn on and off, such as text formatting or
alignment buttons. With `multiple` each item turns on and off by itself; otherwise
turning one on turns the others off, and `deselectable` says whether the one that is on
can be turned off. Items that are on are raised from the track. The group is one Tab
stop: the arrow keys move between the enabled items, wrapping at the ends, and Space or
Enter toggles the focused one. Bind `value`, or set `defaultValue` and listen to
`onValueChange`.

props.name: value
props.doc: The values of the items that are on.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: The items that are on in an uncontrolled group. Defaults to none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with the values that are on after each change.

props.name: multiple
props.doc: Whether several items can be on at once. Defaults to false.

props.name: deselectable
props.doc: Whether the only item that is on can be turned off; ignored with `multiple`. Defaults to true.

props.name: orientation
props.doc: Whether the items run across or down. Defaults to `horizontal`.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether every item is disabled.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The group element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The `ToggleGroup.Item`s.

Item.doc:
A button of a `ToggleGroup.Root` that turns `value` on and off. Give it an `icon`, a
label as children, or both; `label` names an icon-only item and is its tooltip.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value the item turns on and off.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon.

props.name: label
props.doc: The accessible name and tooltip, for an item that shows only an icon.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The label.

Root.doc:
A row (or column) of mutually exclusive choices on a recessed track, with a raised
marker that slides to the selected one. The group is one Tab stop: the arrow keys
select the previous or next enabled segment, wrapping at the ends. Assistive
technologies read it as a group of radio buttons. Bind `value`, or set `defaultValue`
and listen to `onValueChange`.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value of the selected segment, or `null`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: The selected segment of an uncontrolled group. Defaults to `null`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with the value of each newly selected segment.

props.name: orientation
props.doc: Whether the segments run across or down. Defaults to `horizontal`.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether every segment is disabled.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The group element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The `SegmentGroup.Item`s.

Item.doc:
A segment of a `SegmentGroup.Root` that selects `value`: a label with an optional
`icon` before it.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value the segment selects.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon before the label.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The segment element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The label.

Root.doc:
A bar of filter chips for picking one or more options. A selected chip shows the
secondary container fill and, with `showCheckmark`, a check mark before its label. In
the `row` style the chips scroll horizontally, and arrow buttons appear only on the
sides with hidden chips; in the `wrap` style they wrap onto several rows. Unless
`multiple`, selecting a chip unselects the others. Bind `value`, or set `defaultValue`
and listen to `onValueChange`.

props.name: value
props.doc: The values of the selected chips.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: The selected chips of an uncontrolled bar. Defaults to none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with the selected values after each change.

props.name: multiple
props.doc: Whether several chips can be selected at once. Defaults to false.

props.name: layout
props.doc: How chips that don't fit are laid out. Defaults to `row`.

props.name: spacing
props.doc: The space between chips, in pixels. Defaults to 8.

props.name: scrollStep
props.doc: How far one arrow button press scrolls, in pixels. Defaults to 200.

props.name: previousLabel
props.doc: The name of the backward arrow. Defaults to "Scroll back".

props.name: nextLabel
props.doc: The name of the forward arrow. Defaults to "Scroll forward".

props.name: showCheckmark
props.doc: Whether a selected chip shows a check mark. Defaults to true.

props.name: pill
props.doc: Whether the chips are pill-shaped instead of rounded rectangles.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether every chip is disabled.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The bar element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The `ChoiceChipBar.Item`s.

Item.doc: A chip of a `ChoiceChipBar.Root` that selects `value`, with the children as its label.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value the chip selects.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon before the label, replaced by the check mark while selected.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the chip can't be used.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The chip element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The label.

SearchField.doc:
A search text field with a search icon and a clear button that shows while it has text.
Escape clears the text; Escape again on the empty field calls `onEscape`. The hint and
the clear button label follow the active locale.

props.name: value
props.doc: The text.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called whenever the text changes.

props.name: onSubmit
props.doc: Called with the text when the user presses Enter.

props.name: onClear
props.doc: Called after the clear button or Escape empties the field.

props.name: onEscape
props.doc: Called when Escape is pressed on the empty field.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Replaces the search icon before the text.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The input element.

SearchTitleField.doc:
A title bar element that switches between a `title` and a search field, with a toggle
button, as in GNOME apps. It keeps the same size in both states: `fieldWidth` wide and as
tall as a field, with the toggle button at its start. While closed the title follows the
button; while open the field fills the box and the button serves as its search icon.
Escape on the empty field closes the search and returns focus to the button. Bind
`searchActive` and `value`.

props.name: title
props.doc: Shown while the search is closed.

props.name: searchActive
props.doc: Whether the search field shows.

props.name: onSearchActiveChange
props.doc: Called when the search opens or closes.

props.name: value
props.doc: The search text.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called whenever the search text changes.

props.name: onSubmit
props.doc: Called with the text when the user presses Enter.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: The search hint. Defaults to "Search".

props.name: fieldWidth
props.doc: The width of the element in both states, in pixels. Defaults to 260.

props.name: toggleLabel
props.doc: The name of the toggle button. Defaults to "Search".

props.name: ref
props.doc: The element.

PasswordField.doc:
A password text field with a button that shows or hides the text and a warning below it
while Caps Lock is on. Password managers fill it through `autocomplete`; use
`new-password` for a field that sets a new password. Inside a `Field.Root` it takes the
field's label, description and error.

props.name: value
props.doc: The text.

props.name: visible
props.doc: Whether the text shows instead of dots.

props.name: capsLockWarning
props.doc: Whether a warning shows below the focused field while Caps Lock is on. Defaults to true.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Whether the value is invalid.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The input element.

CopyButton.doc:
An icon button that copies `text` to the clipboard. After a copy the icon turns into a
check mark and the label into "Copied" for `feedbackDuration`, and screen readers hear
it. When the platform refuses the copy, such as a browser without clipboard permission,
it shows a cross and "Couldn't copy" instead, and `onError` receives the error.

props.name: text
props.doc: The text copied.

props.name: label
props.doc: The label before copying. Defaults to "Copy".

props.name: onCopied
props.doc: Called after each copy.

props.name: onError
props.doc: Called with the error when the platform refuses a copy.

props.name: feedbackDuration
props.doc: How long the feedback shows, in milliseconds. Defaults to 1500.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The button element.

CopyField.doc:
A read-only field showing `value`, such as a link or a token, with a `CopyButton` at its
end. With `obscure` the value shows as dots, such as for a secret. Inside a `Field.Root`
it takes the field's label.

props.name: value
props.doc: The text shown and copied.

props.name: obscure
props.doc: Whether the value shows as dots.

props.name: onCopied
props.doc: Called after each copy.

props.name: onError
props.doc: Called with the error when the platform refuses a copy.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The input element.

highlightRanges.doc:
Returns the ranges of `text` that match `query` and the other queries, sorted and merged
where they overlap or touch. By default each word matches everywhere, ignoring case and
accents ("acao" matches "Ação").

TextRange.doc: A range of a string, from `start` (included) to `end` (excluded).

HighlightedText.doc:
Text with the matches of a search `query` emphasized, such as search results that show
why each item matched. Each word of `query` and of `queries` matches separately,
ignoring case and accents; overlapping matches merge. Matches are `mark` elements in
bold text-safe primary, without a fill.

props.name: text
props.doc: The full text.

props.name: query
props.doc: The search query.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The element.

EditableLabel.doc:
A text label that turns into a field to rename it in place. A double click, Enter or F2
starts editing with the text selected. Enter or leaving the field keeps the change,
calling `onSubmit` with the trimmed text when it changed and isn't empty; Escape
restores the text. Without `onSubmit` the label is read-only.

props.name: text
props.doc: The label text.

props.name: onSubmit
props.doc: Called with the new, trimmed text after a change.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Shown in the placeholder color while `text` is empty.

props.name: editing
props.doc: Whether the label is being edited.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The label element.

PinEntry.doc:
A code entry drawn as `length` one-character cells, such as a PIN or a one-time code.
One input sits under the cells, so typing, deleting, pasting a whole code and one-time
code autofill work as in any field; a pasted code fills the cells in order. When the
last cell is filled it calls `onComplete` and gives up the focus. With `numeric` only
digits are kept; otherwise spaces are dropped.

props.name: value
props.doc: The code.

props.name: length
props.doc: The number of characters. Defaults to 6.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called whenever the code changes.

props.name: onComplete
props.doc: Called with the code when every cell is filled.

props.name: numeric
props.doc: Whether only digits are accepted. Defaults to true.

props.name: obscure
props.doc: Whether the characters show as dots.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Whether the cells show the error border.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The input element.

addTags.doc:
Appends the accepted texts of `raw` to `tags`, trimmed, and returns the new list and the
refused non-empty texts. A tag is refused when it is empty, repeated (unless
`allowDuplicates`), past `maxTags` or rejected by `validator`.

splitTags.doc:
Splits typed or pasted `text` on `delimiters`: returns the complete parts (to add as
tags) and the text after the last delimiter (to keep in the input), or `null` when it
has no delimiter.

TagRules.doc: The rules a tags field applies to new tags.

TagsField.doc:
A field of tags shown as chips, with a text input after them. Enter or a `delimiters`
character adds the typed text, trimmed, as a tag; a pasted list is split on the
delimiters. A tag is refused when it is empty, repeated (unless `allowDuplicates`), past

formatCompactDate.doc: Formats `date` in the compact numeric form of `locale`, such as `2/3/2026` or `03/02/2026`.

formatTime.doc:
Formats `time` as Flutter's Material widgets do: `9:30 PM` with a 12-hour clock and
`21:30` (hour zero-padded) with a 24-hour one, which defaults to the locale's.

parseCompactDate.doc:
Parses `text` written in the compact numeric date form of `locale` (the day, month and
year in the locale's order, separated as the locale separates them, with or without
leading zeros) and returns the local date at midnight, or `null` when it isn't a real
date in that form.

parseTime.doc:
Parses `text` as `H:MM` or `HH:MM` (also with `.` or `h` as the separator), with an
optional day-period marker before or after the time: `am` or `pm` (any case, or the
locale's own markers), or the letters a and p. Without a marker the hour must be 0 to
23; with one, 1 to 12. Returns `null` for anything else.

uses12HourClock.doc: Whether `locale` writes times with a 12-hour clock.

TimeOfDay.doc: A time of day, without a date.

formatNumber.doc: Formats `value` in the number format of `locale` with exactly `decimals` decimal places.

normalizeNumber.doc: Rounds `value` to `decimals` places and keeps it between `min` and `max`.

parseNumber.doc:
Parses `text` written in the number format of `locale` (its group and decimal
separators, its digits, a leading sign and any spaces) and returns the number, or
`null` when it isn't one.

DateEntry.doc:
A date text field that accepts the locale's compact numeric date (such as `2/3/2026` in
English or `03/02/2026` in Portuguese), with the format as its hint. Dates outside `min`
and `max`, or refused by `isDateAllowed`, are out of range. The error shows after the
field loses focus or Enter is pressed; invalid text keeps the last valid value. A button
at the end opens a `Calendar` in a popover, unless `pickerButton` is false. Bind `value`
(a local date at midnight, or `null`).

props.name: value
props.doc: The date, or `null` for none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with each new valid date, or `null` when the field is emptied.

props.name: onErrorChange
props.doc: Called with the error when the text stops being a valid date, and `null` when it is again.

props.name: min
props.doc: The earliest accepted date.

props.name: max
props.doc: The latest accepted date.

props.name: isDateAllowed
props.doc: Decides which days within the limits are accepted.

props.name: acceptEmpty
props.doc: Whether an empty field is valid. Defaults to true.

props.name: pickerButton
props.doc: Whether a button at the end opens a calendar. Defaults to true.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The input element.

TimeEntry.doc:
A time text field that accepts `H:MM` and `HH:MM`, with an optional AM/PM marker. It
shows times as the locale writes them, `9:30 PM` or `21:30`, unless `use24Hour` says
otherwise. The error shows after the field loses focus or Enter is pressed; invalid text
keeps the last valid value. Bind `value` (`{ hour, minute }`, or `null`).

props.name: value
props.doc: The time, or `null` for none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with each new valid time, or `null` when the field is emptied.

props.name: onErrorChange
props.doc: Called with the error when the text stops being a valid time, and `null` when it is again.

props.name: use24Hour
props.doc: Whether times show with a 24-hour clock. Defaults to the locale's clock.

props.name: acceptEmpty
props.doc: Whether an empty field is valid. Defaults to true.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The input element.

DateTimeEntry.doc:
A `DateEntry` and a `TimeEntry` side by side that report one combined date. An empty
time means midnight; without a date the value is `null`. While either field holds
invalid text the value isn't reported; once both parse it reports the combination if
it changed. `onErrorChange` gets the date error, or else the time error.

props.name: value
props.doc: The date and time, or `null` without a date.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with each new valid combination, or `null` without a date.

props.name: onErrorChange
props.doc: Called with the date error, or else the time error, and `null` when both parse.

props.name: min
props.doc: The earliest accepted date.

props.name: max
props.doc: The latest accepted date.

props.name: dateLabel
props.doc: The accessible name of the date field. Defaults to "Enter Date".

props.name: timeLabel
props.doc: The accessible name of the time field. Defaults to "Enter time".

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether both fields can't be used.

SegmentedEntry.doc:
A row of short text fields joined by a `delimiter`, for values like IP addresses or
license keys. Focus moves to the next segment when one fills up or when the first
visible character of the delimiter is typed in a segment with text, and back to the previous one on Backspace
in an empty segment or on the arrow toward the start at its start; the arrow toward the
end at the end of a segment moves to the next. Bind `value`, one string per segment.

props.name: segments
props.doc: The segments, in order.

props.name: delimiter
props.doc: The text drawn between segments. Defaults to `.`.

props.name: value
props.doc: The text of each segment.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with the text of every segment whenever one changes.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether every segment can't be used.

NumberEntry.doc:
A number field with decrease and increase buttons, like a GNOME spin button. It shows
`value` in the locale's number format with `decimals` places. Typed text is read when
the field loses focus or on Enter, rounded, kept between `min` and `max` and reported;
text that isn't a number is replaced by the current value. The Up and Down arrows step
by `step`, Page Up and Page Down by `pageStep`, and Home and End jump to finite limits.
With focus in the field the mouse wheel steps too, and dragging sideways on the buttons
scrubs the value one step per 4 pixels. Assistive technologies read it as a spin button.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with each new value.

props.name: min
props.doc: The smallest value. Defaults to no limit.

props.name: max
props.doc: The largest value. Defaults to no limit.

props.name: step
props.doc: The change of the arrows, the buttons and the wheel. Defaults to 1.

props.name: pageStep
props.doc: The change of Page Up and Page Down. Defaults to ten steps.

props.name: decimals
props.doc: The decimal places shown and kept, from 0 to 20. Defaults to 0.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The input element.

alignRating.doc: Returns `value` aligned to the rating step (a half or a whole) and kept between 0 and `max`.

angleOf.doc: Returns the angle, clockwise from the top, of the point `dx`, `dy` from the center.

ratingAt.doc:
Returns the rating at `position` pixels from the start of a row of `max` stars of
`size` pixels: a whole value, or with `allowHalf` a half value on the start half of a
star.

snapAngle.doc: Returns `degrees` rounded to the nearest multiple of `step` and wrapped.

wrapAngle.doc: Returns `degrees` wrapped into the range 0 to under 360.

Rating.doc:
A row of `max` stars showing `value`, which the user changes by clicking or with the
keyboard. With `allowHalf` the value moves in halves: the start half of a star gives the
half value. Hovering previews the value under the pointer. The arrow keys change it by
one step, Home and End jump to 0 and `max`, and the digit keys pick that whole value. A
star pops when it fills. Assistive technologies read it as a slider; with `readonly` it
is an image with the value as its name.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value, from 0 to `max`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: The value of an uncontrolled rating at first. Defaults to 0.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with each new value.

props.name: max
props.doc: The number of stars. Defaults to 5.

props.name: allowHalf
props.doc: Whether half values can be picked.

props.name: size
props.doc: The star size, in pixels. Defaults to 24.

props.name: color
props.doc: A CSS color for the filled stars. Defaults to the warning color.

props.name: readonly
props.doc: Whether the value can't be changed.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the rating can't be used.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The element.

AngleSlider.doc:
A round dial that picks an angle in degrees, from 0 at the top clockwise to just under
360, such as a rotation or a gradient direction. Dragging or clicking points the dial
at the pointer, in `step` increments. The arrow keys turn it by `step`, Page Up and Page
Down by `pageStep`, and Home goes back to 0; the value wraps around. `markers` draws
ticks at those angles. Assistive technologies read it as a slider. `onValueCommit`
receives the final angle when a drag ends and after each key press.

props.name: value
props.doc: The angle in degrees, from 0 to under 360.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: The angle of an uncontrolled dial at first. Defaults to 0.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with each new angle.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.doc: Called with the final angle when a drag ends and after each key press.

props.name: step
props.doc: The increment the angle snaps to and the turn of an arrow key. Defaults to 1.

props.name: pageStep
props.doc: The turn of Page Up and Page Down. Defaults to 15.

props.name: markers
props.doc: The angles that get a tick. Defaults to the four quarters.

props.name: size
props.doc: The dial diameter, in pixels. Defaults to 96.

props.name: showValue
props.doc: Whether the angle shows in the middle of the dial. Defaults to true.

props.name: readonly
props.doc: Whether the angle can't be changed.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the dial can't be used.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The element.

PopoverController.doc: Opens and closes a popover. Pass one to `Popover.Root` to open it from code.

popoverPlacement.doc: Returns the floating placement of a popover side and alignment in text direction `dir`.

PopoverAlignment.doc: How a popover lines up with its anchor along the anchor's edge.

PopoverPlacement.doc: The side of its anchor where a popover opens; `start` and `end` follow the text direction.

A non-modal panel anchored to an element, such as a picker or a short form. Compose it
with `Popover.Trigger` (or `Popover.Anchor` and your own button) and `Popover.Content`.
The panel opens on the content's `placement` side, moving to the other side when it
doesn't fit, and follows the anchor as it moves. Escape and a click outside close it; a
popover opened from inside another keeps the outer one open. Bind `open`, or set
`defaultOpen` and listen to `onOpenChange`; or pass a `PopoverController` to open and
close it from code.

props.doc: Whether the panel is open.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Whether an uncontrolled popover starts open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.doc: Called when the panel opens or closes.

props.doc: Opens and closes the panel from code; the root makes its own when unset.

props.name: children
props.doc: The trigger, the anchor and the content.

The button that opens and closes a popover: a `Button` (tonal by default) with the given
props and label, or, with `child`, your own element with the props it receives.

props.name: variant
props.doc: The emphasis of the button. Defaults to `tonal`.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon before the label.

props.name: child
props.doc: Renders the trigger element with the props to spread on it.

props.name: children
props.doc: The label.

Anchor.doc:
Places the popover panel against this element instead of the trigger, such as a whole
field whose button opens the popover.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content.

Content.doc:
The panel of a popover, over the page next to its anchor, in the surface container color
with an outline and a shadow. It opens on the `placement` side (`start` and `end` follow
the text direction), moves to the other side when it doesn't fit and lines up by
`alignment`. With `focusOnOpen` its first focusable element takes focus when it opens;
when it closes with focus inside, focus returns to where it was. Escape closes it, and
so does a click outside unless `closeOnOutsideClick` is false.

props.name: placement
props.doc: The preferred side of the anchor. Defaults to `bottom`.

props.name: alignment
props.doc: The alignment along the anchor's edge. Defaults to `start`.

props.name: offset
props.doc: The gap to the anchor, or to the arrow tip, in pixels. Defaults to 4.

props.name: matchAnchorWidth
props.doc: Whether a panel above or below takes the anchor's width.

props.name: maxWidth
props.doc: The largest panel width, in pixels. Defaults to 360.

props.name: focusOnOpen
props.doc: Whether the panel takes focus when it opens. Defaults to true.

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.doc: Whether a click outside the anchor and the panel closes it. Defaults to true.

props.name: flush
props.doc: Whether the panel has no padding, for content that sets its own.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The panel element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content.

Arrow.doc:
An arrow on the edge of a popover panel, pointing at its anchor. Place it inside
`Popover.Content`.

Close.doc:
A button inside a popover that closes it: a `CloseButton`, or a `Button` with the given
label as children.

props.name: variant
props.doc: The emphasis of a labeled button. Defaults to `text`.

props.name: children
props.doc: The label; without it the button is an X.

props.name: children
props.doc: The text.

A card of extra detail that opens over a `HoverCard.Trigger` while the pointer rests on
it or keyboard focus is inside it, such as a profile preview on a user name. It opens
after `openDelay` and closes `closeDelay` after the pointer leaves both the trigger and
the card, or focus leaves the trigger. A long press opens it on touch screens; Escape
and a click outside close it. The card doesn't take focus, so its content must only
repeat or preview what the trigger leads to.

props.name: open
props.doc: Whether the card is open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.doc: Called when the card opens or closes.

props.name: openDelay
props.doc: The wait before the card opens, in milliseconds. Defaults to 500.

props.name: closeDelay
props.doc: The wait before the card closes, in milliseconds. Defaults to 300.

props.name: children
props.doc: The trigger and the content.

The element a hover card describes, such as a link or a user name; its children are
wrapped in an inline element that watches the pointer, focus and long presses. While
the card is open, it describes the first focusable element inside.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content.

The card of a hover card, next to the trigger (below it, centered, by default) with an
arrow. Moving the pointer onto it keeps it open.

props.name: placement
props.doc: The preferred side of the trigger. Defaults to `bottom`.

props.name: alignment
props.doc: The alignment along the trigger's edge. Defaults to `center`.

props.name: arrow
props.doc: Whether the card points at the trigger with an arrow. Defaults to true.

props.name: maxWidth
props.doc: The largest card width, in pixels. Defaults to 320.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content.

A menu that opens over a `ContextMenu.Trigger` on a secondary click, a long press,
Shift+F10 or the menu key. Its `ContextMenu.Content` holds the items of `Menu`
(`Menu.Item`, `Menu.CheckboxItem`, `Menu.Sub`…). It opens where the pointer is, or over
the middle of the trigger from the keyboard, with the first item focused.

props.name: open
props.doc: Whether the menu is open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.doc: Called when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: children
props.doc: The trigger and the content.

The area a context menu belongs to. The browser's own menu doesn't open over it unless
`disabled`.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Whether the menu can't open; the browser's menu shows instead.

props.name: ref
props.doc: The area element.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content.

The items of a context menu, in a panel at the point where it opened. Choosing an item,
Escape, Tab or a click outside closes it, and focus goes back where it was.

addDays.doc: Returns `date` moved by `days` days, at midnight.

addMonths.doc: Returns the same day number `months` months away, kept within that month's length.

daysInMonth.doc: Returns the number of days of `month` (0 to 11) in `year`.

firstDayOfWeek.doc:
Returns the first day of the week of `locale`, from 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday): Sunday
for English and Portuguese, as Flutter's Material calendar has it, else the engine's
week info for the locale when it has one, else Monday.

isoWeekNumber.doc: Returns the ISO 8601 week number of `date`: weeks start on Monday and week 1 holds the year's first Thursday.

monthWeeks.doc:
Returns the weeks of the month of `month` (any day in it) as rows of seven days, the
week starting on `weekStart` (0 is Sunday); days of the neighboring months are `null`.

DateRange.doc: A range of dates, both days included.

A month grid that picks a date, or a range of dates with `range`. The header changes the
month. The grid has one Tab stop, the focused day: the arrows move by a day or a week,
Home and End to the start and end of the week, Page Up and Page Down by a month (a year
with Shift), and Enter or Space picks the focused day. A range takes two picks, in any
order. Days outside `min` and `max`, or refused by `isDateAllowed`, can't be picked.
Week numbers follow ISO 8601. Bind `value`, or `rangeValue` in range mode.

props.doc: The picked date, in single mode.

props.name: onValueChange
props.doc: Called with each picked date, in single mode.

props.doc: Whether the calendar picks a range.

props.doc: The picked range, in range mode.

props.doc: Called with each completed range.

props.doc: The latest date that can be picked.

props.doc: The day marked as today. Defaults to the current date.
